natural: insight into the ways of the world

meaning.en: To see clearly how the world and human affairs really work.
meaning.zh: 对社会和人情世故看得清楚透彻。

equivalents: see the world for what it is
have a shrewd grasp of worldly affairs

examples.zh: 他阅历丰富，洞察世事，很少被表象迷惑。
examples.en: Experienced and worldly-wise, he is rarely taken in by appearances.

examples.zh: 这位老作家洞察世事，笔下人物都很真实。
examples.en: The old writer understands the world well, and his characters feel real.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or attributive; describes a perceptive, experienced person.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，形容阅历丰富、看得明白的人。

meaning.en: To understand human affairs so thoroughly that one has no illusions left.
meaning.zh: 对世间的人情世故看得十分透彻，不再抱有幻想。

equivalents: have no illusions about the world

examples.zh: 他看透世事后，反而活得更加平静。
examples.en: Having seen through the world, he now lives more peacefully.

examples.zh: 看透世事的老人，只想守着小院过日子。
examples.en: The old man, past all illusions, only wants to potter about his courtyard.

usage.en: Often a predicate; can imply either calm wisdom or disillusionment, depending on context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，语气可以是淡泊，也可以带点失望。

meaning.en: Living conditions that are hard and short of comforts.
meaning.zh: 生活条件差，日子过得辛苦。

examples.zh: 那几年生活艰苦，一家人常常吃不饱。
examples.en: Life was hard in those years and the family often went hungry.

examples.zh: 山区的老师生活艰苦，却从不抱怨。
examples.en: Teachers in the mountains live a hard life yet never complain.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. The variant 生活清苦 stresses poverty and plainness more than toil.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语；“生活清苦”更侧重清贫。

meaning.en: To be a kind-hearted person.
meaning.zh: 做人心地好，待人善意。

examples.zh: 她为人善良，邻居有困难总会帮忙。
examples.en: She is kind-hearted and always helps neighbours in trouble.

examples.zh: 大家都喜欢他，因为他为人善良又不计较。
examples.en: Everyone likes him, for he is kind and never petty.

usage.en: Predicate describing character; 为人 + adjective is a common pattern (为人正直, 为人老实).
usage.zh: 作谓语，“为人＋形容词”是常见格式。

meaning.en: Faithful to others and reliable in what one does.
meaning.zh: 对人忠心诚恳，办事值得信赖。

examples.zh: 他忠诚可靠，老板把重要事务都交给他。
examples.en: Loyal and dependable, he is trusted by the boss with all key matters.

examples.zh: 找个忠诚可靠的合伙人比什么都重要。
examples.en: Finding a loyal, dependable partner matters more than anything.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; used of people, partners, employees and friends.
usage.zh: 可作定语或谓语，多用于人。

meaning.en: Honest and content to do one's own duty without showing off or cheating.
meaning.zh: 为人诚实，安分守己，踏踏实实做事。

examples.zh: 老张是个诚实本分的生意人，从不缺斤少两。
examples.en: Old Zhang is an honest tradesman who never gives short weight.

examples.zh: 她诚实本分，同事们都信得过她。
examples.en: Honest and unassuming, she is trusted by all her colleagues.

usage.en: Mostly an attributive for ordinary people; the tone is warm and slightly plain.
usage.zh: 多作定语，形容普通、踏实的人，带亲切色彩。

meaning.en: Unable to tolerate others or let small slights go.
meaning.zh: 度量小，容不得人，爱计较。

examples.zh: 他气量狭小，被批评一句就记恨好几年。
examples.en: Small-minded, he bears a grudge for years over a single criticism.

examples.zh: 气量狭小的人很难当好领导。
examples.en: A petty person rarely makes a good leader.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; a criticism of character.
usage.zh: 作定语或谓语，含贬义。

literal: not at all · without · feeling · emotion

meaning.en: Showing no feeling or warmth at all.
meaning.zh: 一点感情也没有，冷淡无情。

examples.zh: 他毫无感情地念完了判决书。
examples.en: He read out the verdict without a trace of feeling.

examples.zh: 这段婚姻早已毫无感情，只剩下责任。
examples.en: There was no feeling left in the marriage, only duty.

usage.en: Adverbial 毫无感情地 + verb, or predicate. 毫无 is formal and emphatic.
usage.zh: 常作状语（毫无感情地……）或谓语；“毫无”语气强、较书面。

meaning.en: Crooked and uneven, not straight.
meaning.zh: 弯弯曲曲，不端正，不整齐。

examples.zh: 孩子在本子上写了几个歪歪扭扭的字。
examples.en: The child wrote a few wobbly characters in the notebook.

examples.zh: 这条田埂走起来歪歪扭扭的。
examples.en: The path along the field bank twists and wobbles.

usage.en: AABB-reduplicated; usually attributive or complement (走得歪歪扭扭).
usage.zh: AABB 重叠式，多作定语或补语（写得歪歪扭扭）。

meaning.en: To face things calmly, without getting emotional.
meaning.zh: 面对事情不慌张、不冲动。

examples.zh: 遇到纠纷，他态度冷静，没有跟对方争吵。
examples.en: In the dispute he stayed calm and did not argue back.

examples.zh: 专家呼吁大家态度冷静，不要轻信谣言。
examples.en: Experts urged everyone to stay calm and not believe rumours.

usage.en: Predicate, or 保持态度冷静. Common in news and advice.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“保持态度冷静”，新闻和劝告中常见。

meaning.en: To lose heart and hope after a setback.
meaning.zh: 遇到挫折后丧失信心和希望。

examples.zh: 一次失败不必灰心失望，下次再来。
examples.en: One failure is no reason to lose heart; try again next time.

examples.zh: 看到成绩单，他灰心失望地低下了头。
examples.en: Seeing his results, he bowed his head, utterly disheartened.

usage.en: Predicate, or adverbial with 地; often used when encouraging someone (别灰心失望).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，常用于劝慰（别灰心失望）。

meaning.en: Having one's drive and determination worn away; despondent.
meaning.zh: 斗志减退，情绪低落，提不起劲。

examples.zh: 失业后他意志消沉，整天待在家里。
examples.en: After losing his job he fell into despondency and stayed home all day.

examples.zh: 球队连败，队员们意志消沉。
examples.en: After losing again and again, the players were demoralised.

usage.en: Predicate; describes a lasting low mood, stronger than ordinary sadness.
usage.zh: 作谓语，指持续的低落，比一般难过更重。

meaning.en: To use force wantonly or beyond what is justified.
meaning.zh: 不加节制、不合理地使用暴力或军事力量。

examples.zh: 联合国谴责任何滥用武力的行为。
examples.en: The UN condemns any reckless use of force.

examples.zh: 警察滥用武力，引起了公众的不满。
examples.en: The police's excessive force angered the public.

usage.en: Verb-object; typical of news and legal writing.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多见于新闻和法律文书。

meaning.en: To handle things flexibly, adjusting to circumstances rather than sticking to rules.
meaning.zh: 处理问题灵活，不死守规矩，善于根据情况调整。

examples.zh: 做生意要灵活变通，不能一条路走到黑。
examples.en: In business you must be flexible and not stubbornly stick to one road.

examples.zh: 老师教导我们遇到难题要灵活变通。
examples.en: The teacher taught us to be adaptable when facing hard problems.

usage.en: Predicate; also with 懂得/善于 (善于灵活变通).
usage.zh: 作谓语；常说“善于灵活变通”。

meaning.en: To be content with what one has and not want more.
meaning.zh: 对已有的感到满意，不贪求更多。

examples.zh: 人只要知道满足，日子就过得轻松。
examples.en: As long as you know when you have enough, life is easier.

examples.zh: 她知道满足，从不和别人攀比。
examples.en: She is content with what she has and never compares herself with others.

usage.en: Predicate; a plain, everyday way of saying 知足常乐.
usage.zh: 作谓语，是“知足常乐”的口语化说法。

literal: pile up · lay bricks · diction · flowery words

meaning.en: To stuff writing with ornate words that add no real content.
meaning.zh: 文章中堆起大量华丽的词语，却没有实在内容。

examples.zh: 好文章不靠堆砌辞藻，而靠真情实感。
examples.en: A good essay relies on real feeling, not on piled-up flowery words.

examples.zh: 这篇稿子只是堆砌辞藻，读完什么也没记住。
examples.en: The piece is just purple prose; I remembered nothing after reading it.

usage.en: Verb-object; used in criticism of writing and speeches.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，用于批评文章或讲话华而不实。

meaning.en: Relaxed and comfortable, free of worry or hurry.
meaning.zh: 清闲自在，舒服惬意。

examples.zh: 退休后他过着安闲舒适的生活。
examples.en: After retiring he leads a leisurely, comfortable life.

examples.zh: 这家民宿环境安闲舒适，适合度假。
examples.en: The guesthouse is calm and comfortable, ideal for a holiday.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; describes lifestyles and places.
usage.zh: 作定语或谓语，形容生活或环境。

meaning.en: To treat something as unimportant and pay no heed to it.
meaning.zh: 不把某事看作重要的事，不放在心上。

examples.zh: 医生的叮嘱，他一点也不当回事。
examples.en: He took none of the doctor's advice seriously.

examples.zh: 别把安全规定不当回事，出了事就晚了。
examples.en: Don't brush safety rules off; it will be too late once something happens.

usage.en: Colloquial; often 不当回事 after an object (把……不当回事).
usage.zh: 口语，常说“把……不当回事”。

meaning.en: Taking work seriously and answering for the results.
meaning.zh: 对待工作严肃认真，并承担责任。

examples.zh: 小李工作认真负责，从没出过差错。
examples.en: Xiao Li is conscientious at work and has never made a mistake.

examples.zh: 医生对病人要认真负责。
examples.en: Doctors must be conscientious towards their patients.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive, or 的 phrase; a standard word in appraisals and references.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常见于评语和鉴定。

meaning.en: Mountains stretching on without a break.
meaning.zh: 山峰一座接一座，连续不断。

examples.zh: 远处山势连绵，一直延伸到天边。
examples.en: In the distance the mountains stretch unbroken to the horizon.

examples.zh: 山势连绵，修一条铁路谈何容易。
examples.en: With the mountains running on and on, building a railway is no easy matter.

usage.en: Predicate in scenery descriptions; common in travel writing.
usage.zh: 描写景物时作谓语，常见于游记。

meaning.en: Lovely scenery of hills and water.
meaning.zh: 山和水都很美，风景优美。

examples.zh: 桂林山水秀丽，吸引了各国游客。
examples.en: Guilin's scenery is lovely and draws visitors from many countries.

examples.zh: 我的家乡山水秀丽，四季分明。
examples.en: My hometown has beautiful scenery and four distinct seasons.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a stock phrase in tourism writing.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，旅游文字中的常用语。

meaning.en: Having a quick, fierce temper.
meaning.zh: 性情急躁，容易发火。

examples.zh: 他脾气暴躁，一言不合就拍桌子。
examples.en: He is hot-tempered and bangs the table at the slightest disagreement.

examples.zh: 孩子脾气暴躁，家长要耐心引导。
examples.en: When a child has a quick temper, parents should guide them patiently.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; describes a person's disposition.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，形容人的性情。

meaning.en: To be a person of honest and upright character.
meaning.zh: 做人公正诚实，不偏不邪。

examples.zh: 他为人正直，从不收人好处。
examples.en: He is a man of integrity and never accepts favours.

examples.zh: 法官必须为人正直，办案公正。
examples.en: A judge must be upright and fair in handling cases.

usage.en: Predicate; 为人 + adjective describes character.
usage.zh: 作谓语，“为人＋形容词”描写品性。

meaning.en: To be an honest, plain-dealing person, sometimes to the point of being easily taken advantage of.
meaning.zh: 做人诚实、不耍心眼，有时也指容易吃亏。

examples.zh: 他为人老实，从来不会说谎。
examples.en: He is an honest soul who can't tell a lie.

examples.zh: 为人老实是优点，但也要学会保护自己。
examples.en: Being honest is a virtue, but you must also learn to protect yourself.

usage.en: Predicate; may carry a hint of sympathy that the person is easily cheated.
usage.zh: 作谓语，有时带“易吃亏”的同情意味。

meaning.en: To deal with matters skilfully, with the poise of long experience.
meaning.zh: 处理事情熟练稳重，经验丰富。

equivalents: handle things like a seasoned hand

examples.zh: 她年纪不大，处事老练，深得领导信任。
examples.en: Though young, she handles things with skill and is trusted by her leaders.

examples.zh: 谈判桌上他处事老练，毫不慌乱。
examples.en: At the negotiating table he was seasoned and never flustered.

usage.en: Predicate. The variant 办事老练 focuses on getting jobs done.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“办事老练”偏重办具体事务。

meaning.en: Competing under the same rules, without cheating or favouritism.
meaning.zh: 在同样的规则下比拼，不作弊、不偏袒。

examples.zh: 市场需要公平竞争，才能保护消费者。
examples.en: Markets need fair competition to protect consumers.

examples.zh: 比赛应该公平竞争，不能靠关系。
examples.en: Contests should be fairly run, not decided by connections.

usage.en: Noun phrase or verb-object; frequent in economics, law and sport.
usage.zh: 可作名词短语或动宾结构，常见于经济、法律和体育。

meaning.en: A lively, prosperous and bustling sight.
meaning.zh: 城市或街市热闹兴旺。

examples.zh: 夜幕降临，商业街景象繁华。
examples.en: As night falls, the shopping street is a thriving sight.

examples.zh: 改革开放后，沿海城市景象繁华。
examples.en: After reform and opening-up, the coastal cities took on a prosperous look.

usage.en: Predicate; used of cities, markets and streets.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于城市、集市和街道。

literal: to the full · feeling · merry · joy

meaning.en: To give oneself entirely to fun and celebration.
meaning.zh: 毫无保留地享受快乐。

examples.zh: 今晚大家尽情欢乐，不醉不归。
examples.en: Tonight let's enjoy ourselves to the full and not leave sober.

examples.zh: 孩子们在游乐园里尽情欢乐。
examples.en: The children had the time of their lives at the amusement park.

usage.en: Verb phrase; 尽情 works as an adverb before many verbs (尽情歌唱).
usage.zh: 动词性短语；“尽情”可作状语（尽情歌唱）。

meaning.en: To act carefully and avoid risks or slips.
meaning.zh: 做事小心，不冒失。

examples.zh: 投资时要谨慎行事，不要盲目跟风。
examples.en: Invest with caution; don't follow the crowd blindly.

examples.zh: 他一向谨慎行事，所以很少出错。
examples.en: He always acts carefully, so he rarely makes mistakes.

usage.en: Verb phrase, often in advice or warnings (务必谨慎行事).
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常用于劝告（务必谨慎行事）。

meaning.en: To stop being watchful and so become exposed to danger.
meaning.zh: 放松戒备，不再留心危险。

examples.zh: 一旦失去警惕，骗子就会趁虚而入。
examples.en: Once you let your guard down, fraudsters will take advantage.

examples.zh: 连胜之后球队失去警惕，意外输了比赛。
examples.en: After a winning run the team lost its edge and unexpectedly lost.

usage.en: Verb-object; used in warnings about security, health and competition.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，用于安全、健康、竞争等方面的告诫。

meaning.en: Using cruel and merciless means to reach one's ends.
meaning.zh: 使用的办法阴狠残忍。

examples.zh: 这伙骗子手段毒辣，专门坑老年人。
examples.en: The gang are ruthless operators who prey on the elderly.

examples.zh: 他手段毒辣，对手无一幸免。
examples.en: Ruthless in his methods, none of his rivals escaped him.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; carries strong disapproval.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，贬义强烈。

meaning.en: Having a cruel and merciless nature.
meaning.zh: 心地残忍，对人毫不留情。

examples.zh: 故事里的后母心肠凶狠，常常虐待孩子。
examples.en: The stepmother in the story is cruel-hearted and often mistreats the child.

examples.zh: 别看他外表斯文，其实心肠凶狠。
examples.en: He looks gentle, but at heart he is merciless.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical of stories and character descriptions.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常见于故事和人物描写。

meaning.en: Failing to take responsibility for what one does or has promised.
meaning.zh: 对自己的言行和职责不负起责任。

examples.zh: 随口承诺又不兑现，这是不负责任的做法。
examples.en: Making promises off the cuff and not keeping them is irresponsible.

examples.zh: 把孩子丢给老人就不管，实在不负责任。
examples.en: Leaving the child to the grandparents and walking away is really irresponsible.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (不负责任的话). A very common criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（不负责任的话），是常见的批评语。

meaning.en: Toughened and skilled through long training and experience.
meaning.zh: 经过长期的磨炼和考验，变得成熟坚强。

examples.zh: 这支久经锻炼的队伍，不怕任何困难。
examples.en: This well-seasoned team fears no difficulty.

examples.zh: 他久经锻炼，遇事沉着冷静。
examples.en: Tempered by long experience, he stays composed when trouble comes.

usage.en: Mostly attributive before 的 or before a noun like 队伍/干部.
usage.zh: 多作定语，修饰队伍、干部等。

meaning.en: To flatter people in power in a servile way.
meaning.zh: 用讨好的话和姿态巴结有权势的人。

examples.zh: 他靠谄媚奉承博得领导的欢心。
examples.en: He won his boss's favour by fawning on him.

examples.zh: 真正的朋友不会谄媚奉承，而会说真话。
examples.en: A true friend does not toady but tells the truth.

usage.en: Verb phrase or attributive; strongly disapproving.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，贬义明显。

meaning.en: Plain and unassuming in appearance and dress.
meaning.zh: 穿着打扮简单，不华丽。

examples.zh: 这位亿万富翁外表朴素，常穿旧夹克。
examples.en: The billionaire looks plain and often wears an old jacket.

examples.zh: 别看他外表朴素，其实很有学问。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his plain look; he is very learned.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often followed by a contrast (外表朴素，内心……).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，后面常接转折（外表朴素，内心……）。

meaning.en: Acting without first finding out what really happened.
meaning.zh: 不先弄清事情的来龙去脉就下判断或行动。

examples.zh: 老师不问情由，就把两个孩子都批评了一顿。
examples.en: Without asking what happened, the teacher scolded both children.

examples.zh: 遇事不问情由就发火，只会激化矛盾。
examples.en: Flaring up without asking why only makes the quarrel worse.

usage.en: Usually adverbial before a verb of judging or punishing.
usage.zh: 多作状语，修饰批评、处罚等动词。

meaning.en: To push forward with courage and vigour.
meaning.zh: 鼓起勇气，奋力向前。

examples.zh: 战士们冒着炮火奋勇前进。
examples.en: The soldiers pressed bravely forward under fire.

examples.zh: 面对困难，我们要奋勇前进，决不后退。
examples.en: Facing difficulties, we must forge ahead and never retreat.

usage.en: Verb phrase; common in slogans, speeches and military writing.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常见于口号、讲话和军事文字。

meaning.en: A work whose imagery and atmosphere feel wide and far-reaching.
meaning.zh: 诗文或画面所表现的境界宏大、视野宽广。

examples.zh: 这首诗意境开阔，读来令人心胸舒展。
examples.en: The poem is expansive in vision and lifts the reader's heart.

examples.zh: 王维的山水诗意境开阔，耐人寻味。
examples.en: Wang Wei's landscape poems have an expansive spirit worth savouring.

usage.en: Used in literary and art criticism; predicate or 的-phrase.
usage.zh: 用于文学和艺术评论，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Suddenly feeling a rush of heroic, high-spirited emotion.
meaning.zh: 一下子涌起豪迈壮阔的情怀。

examples.zh: 站在长城上，我不禁豪情顿生。
examples.en: Standing on the Great Wall, I couldn't help feeling a surge of pride.

examples.zh: 听着激昂的军歌，他豪情顿生。
examples.en: Hearing the rousing march, he felt a sudden rush of courage.

usage.en: Predicate, usually after a scene or event that stirs the feeling.
usage.zh: 作谓语，前面常有触发情感的情景。

meaning.en: To treat others with true sincerity.
meaning.zh: 用真诚的心对待别人。

examples.zh: 只有真心相待，才能交到真正的朋友。
examples.en: Only by treating people sincerely can you make true friends.

examples.zh: 两家人多年来真心相待，亲如一家。
examples.en: The two families have treated each other sincerely for years, like one family.

usage.en: Verb phrase; 相 here marks mutual action, so it often describes a two-way relationship.
usage.zh: 动词性短语；“相”表示双方互相，常用于双向关系。

literal: exhaust · to the utmost · loyalty · sincerity

meaning.en: To devote one's entire loyalty to a person or cause.
meaning.zh: 把全部的忠心都献出来。

examples.zh: 他竭尽忠诚，辅佐主公三十年。
examples.en: He gave his utmost loyalty, serving his lord for thirty years.

examples.zh: 战士们竭尽忠诚，保卫祖国的边疆。
examples.en: The soldiers gave all their loyalty to guarding the nation's frontier.

usage.en: Verb phrase; solemn and slightly literary.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，语气庄重，略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: To reduce spending and save money.
meaning.zh: 减少不必要的花费。

examples.zh: 公司要节约开支，先从减少差旅费做起。
examples.en: The firm needs to cut costs, starting with travel expenses.

examples.zh: 为了节约开支，他们决定自己动手装修。
examples.en: To save money, they decided to do the decorating themselves.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in business, household and government contexts.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于企业、家庭和政府场合。

meaning.en: To dig into the full background and hidden details of a matter.
meaning.zh: 追问事情的来历和内情。

equivalents: get to the bottom of it

examples.zh: 警方正在追究底细，查清案件的来龙去脉。
examples.en: The police are getting to the bottom of the case.

examples.zh: 他喜欢追究底细，问个没完。
examples.en: He likes to probe into everything and keeps asking questions.

usage.en: Verb-object; can be neutral or slightly negative if nosy.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，中性，有时略带“多事”的意味。

meaning.en: The whole family coming together.
meaning.zh: 一家人聚在一起。

examples.zh: 春节是全家团聚的日子。
examples.en: The Spring Festival is when the whole family comes together.

examples.zh: 在外打拼多年，他终于盼到全家团聚。
examples.en: After years working away, he finally saw the family reunited.

usage.en: Verb phrase; strongly tied to festivals and homecomings.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常与节日、回家联系。

literal: secretly · in the dark · collude · tie up

meaning.en: To work with others secretly for improper ends.
meaning.zh: 背地里互相串通，做不正当的事。

examples.zh: 他们暗中勾结，把公款分掉了。
examples.en: They colluded in secret and shared out the public funds.

examples.zh: 警方查出官员与商人暗中勾结。
examples.en: Police found the official had been in secret collusion with a businessman.

usage.en: Verb phrase; strongly negative, common in news about crime and corruption.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，贬义强，常见于犯罪、腐败的报道。

meaning.en: Having firmly decided what to do.
meaning.zh: 已经拿定主意，不再动摇。

examples.zh: 我主意已定，谁劝也没用。
examples.en: My mind is made up; no one can talk me out of it.

examples.zh: 他主意已定，明天就辞职。
examples.en: He has made up his mind to resign tomorrow.

usage.en: Predicate, often followed by a firm statement of what will be done.
usage.zh: 作谓语，后面常接决定要做的事。
